The T2-FLAIR mismatch sign is absent (score 0.476, degree 0.473), which argues against IDH-mutant astrocytoma. But the tumor location includes cortex and insula, which are common in IDH-mutant tumors. The midline epicenter and bilateral involvement suggest possible glioblastoma, but the proportion necrosis (34.29%) is lower than typical GBM. Overall, IDH-mutant is favored due to cortical involvement and ependymal invasion.
